rationale: The strongest local family already depends on staged reverse-tail recurrence, but the old schedule keyed progress to nominal iterations even though runs stop on a 600s wallclock budget. This change aligns tail recurrence ramping to the actual usable train-time budget before reserved final eval, so the recurrent tail should reach its intended late-phase behavior more consistently on capped Mac-mini runs without adding parameter bytes or hot-path compile churn.
title: Wallclock-Aligned Reverse-Tail Curriculum
